# Brahim Bousnguar

> Senior E-Commerce Integration Consultant with 9+ years of experience specializing in SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris/CCv2), MuleSoft Anypoint Platform, and Salesforce integration. Based in France, working with enterprise clients across 15+ countries. Bilingual English/French.

Key facts:

- Current role: MuleSoft Integration Specialist at Roche Bobois (since January 2025) — API-led integration architecture, DataWeave, Salesforce CRM data flows.
- Previous: Senior SAP Commerce Cloud Consultant at Miele (2022–2024, cloud-native CCv2 migration + SAP BTP Kyma microservices); Technical Lead at BYK (2018–2021, multi-country B2B platform, Hybris 6.7 → CCv2); SAP Hybris Integration Specialist at SEB Group (2016–2018, multi-brand platform).
- Certifications: GitHub Copilot (GH-300) (Sep 2026); SAP Certified — Solution Architect — SAP Customer Experience (Mar 2026); SAP Certified — Positioning SAP Customer Experience Solutions (Mar 2026); SAP Certified — Business User — SAP Commerce Cloud (Mar 2025); SAP Certified Development Professional — SAP Commerce Cloud Developer (2023); SAP Certified Associate — Hybris Commerce Business Analyst 6.3 (2018). Currently pursuing MuleSoft Anypoint Platform certifications. The 2026 and 2025 SAP certifications are verifiable on Credly: https://www.credly.com/users/brahim-bousnguar. The GitHub Copilot certification is verifiable on Microsoft Learn: https://learn.microsoft.com/api/credentials/share/en-us/BrahimBousnguar-7690/20B68101386B5A?sharingId=9C9C9C1DC7CAD24F
- AI-augmented workflow: daily use of GitHub Copilot, Ollama-based LLM CLI tooling, Claude, and OpenAI Codex CLI. Side projects around MCP servers, local LLM benchmarking, and AI coding-assistant cost tracking.
- Education: State Engineer in Computer Science & Business Intelligence, INSEA Rabat (2015).

## Notes

<!-- notes:start -->
- [Reading MuleSoft Anypoint logs from an AI agent: why I built mulewatch](https://heybrahim.com/notes/mulewatch-anypoint-logs-mcp.html) (2026-09-18): MuleSoft's official MCP server builds and deploys Mule apps but cannot read application logs. mulewatch is a read-only MCP server that fetches live and archived Anypoint logs, finding the right replica in a handful of calls. Markdown: https://heybrahim.com/notes/mulewatch-anypoint-logs-mcp.md
